C0866.title: Company in Laishan, Yantai Hit by WannaCry Ransomware Attack
C0866.summary: A 2025 related notice said the cyber unit of Laishan public security in Yantai received a report from a local company that its server had been infected by ransomware and its database was locked. Investigation found that attackers exploited a business system file-upload vulnerability to implant a backdoor and deploy ransomware, causing many files to be encrypted; the page also described typical characteristics of WannaCry ransomware.

references.title: Cyber Shield 2025: Beware of Ransomware Attacks Targeting You
